verifications.claim: SpaceX successfully launched 29 Starlink satellites via a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on Sunday, March 22, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket lifts off from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station... on Sunday, March 22, 2026.' 'SpaceX confirms deployment of the 29 Starlink satellites.'; R3: 'SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket... Sunday, March 22... 29 Starlink satellites'; R6: 'Starlink Mission Falcon 9 SLC-40, Florida... March 22, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Direct match on all details including success (deployment), date, location, vehicle, payload number in R2 primary, supported by R3 and R6.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Launch took place at 10:47 a.m. EDT (1447 UTC)'
verifications.reasoning: Exact time and timezone directly stated.

verifications.claim: The mission was the 37th mission of the year.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches the mission count for the year.
